purpose: Coauthor proposals: sensitivity of inferential summaries to initialization and improvement with longer chains.
scope: 12 deliberately selected completed FALSE cases: three per n=40/80/160/320; varsel FALSE; same model, data, priors and proposals.
selection: Previous first-task anchor; lowest task id passing original six-parameter criterion (at n40 no pass exists, use middle-ranked beta Rhat among remaining cases); highest beta Rhat among remaining non-pass cases. Based on existing diagnostics, not beta error or extension outcomes. Illustrative, not population-representative.
initializations: new four randomized starts with seed 16000000+task_id
new four randomized starts with seed 17000000+task_id
initialization_distribution: Same original starting-value generator and ranges for all three sets. Only initial states differ; same four original sampler seeds used across initialization sets.
warmup_sensitivity: Discard first half at each budget (10k coincides with primary); additional analysis using the same trajectories.
targets: beta mean, SD, 95% interval, error relative to true beta=0.5, interval containing truth/zero, P(beta>0), MCSE; original six-parameter Rhat/bulk/tail ESS; chain-specific beta summaries.
h_scope: No new h postprocessing in this experiment; existing all-observed-point h analysis remains a separate supplementary result.
comparisons: Within each dataset, compare initialization sets at a fixed budget and nested prefixes within a fixed initialization set. Same sampler seeds across sets induce dependence; do not pool sets as independent chains or use independent-SE tests. No causal effect of diagnostic classification or population failure-rate estimate.
failure_handling: Run all four independent chains. Record sampler errors and retain only fully completed iterations before the failing update when recoverable. Evaluate a budget only if all four chains completed it. Later numerical failures remain recorded even when shorter prefixes are evaluable. Technical validation failures halt further dispatch.
verification: Original initialization: retained iterations 5001:10000 exactly match previous FALSE six-parameter draws chain by chain; versions/starts/data/RNG fixed. Scripts and selection frozen before extension outcomes.
retention: Retain all six-parameter trajectories for all 144 chains (including initial/warmup iterations) plus statuses, seeds, diagnostics and chain summaries. Do not discard these raw draws; lightweight deliverables contain a bounded subset, with full raw trajectories local.
interpretation: Long-run failure is evidence of unresolved computation under the tested budgets and may be consistent with weak identification; it is not by itself a proof of insufficient data information.
